evidence.note: Discovers Key-Focus Heads (KFHs) -- a small subset of attention heads that, during final-answer generation, naturally attend more to essential reasoning steps than redundant ones -- and builds ATTNPO, an RL framework that rescales GRPO's outcome-level advantage per reasoning step using KFH attention scores, cutting reasoning length 55-61% while improving accuracy +2.9 to +7.3 points on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B.
evidence.title: AttnPO: Attention-Guided Process Supervision for Efficient Reasoning
